title: Error reporting surface: in-app error message with a "Tell us about it" report action
decision: Every failure surfaced to a player shall be presented as a clear, human-readable error message in the application's own interface, accompanied by a "Tell us about it" action that lets the player submit a report about the failure from within the session. The error message and the report action are part of the application's own surface; no separate support channel, external ticketing destination, or out-of-band contact path is introduced for reporting failures.
rationale: The founder register records this class as decided: "A clear error message with a \"Tell us about it\" button." with the reason "This way we'll be notified of bugs and improve." This ADR implements that decision directly: the failure surface is an in-app message (the "clear error message") plus a single adjacent report affordance (the "Tell us about it" button) that routes the player's report back to the team so bugs are learned about and the product improves. Placing the report action inside the application keeps it reachable at the moment of failure, which is the only moment the player has the context needed to describe what went wrong, and it keeps the failure surface consistent with the chat-style interface the app follows. It also keeps the failure path self-contained, so a session that hits an error does not depend on any external system or service to let the player report it.

options_considered.option: Silent failure handling: log the failure internally and let the session continue or retry without telling the player
options_considered.reason: Rejected because it produces no clear error message for the player and no report path, so the team would not be notified of bugs and could not improve, which is the stated purpose of the founder's decision.

options_considered.option: Out-of-band reporting: show a generic failure notice and direct players to an external support channel or contact address
options_considered.reason: Rejected because it moves reporting outside the application, loses the player's in-session context at the moment of failure, and adds a dependency on an external service for a first-release failure path.

options_considered.option: Automatic telemetry-only reporting: capture failure diagnostics automatically with no player-facing message or action
options_considered.reason: Rejected because it omits the clear error message the founder required and gives the player no way to describe what they were doing, so reports would lack the context needed to fix the bug.
